messages:
Devin K: Quick RFC follow-up — who owns the surface for precision-profile selection across CrossPlane + runtime? I think we should move the selection out of per-model runtime config and into a CrossPlane abstraction so ops can pin profiles per-customer. Thoughts?

Mira S: moving it up makes sense for customer overrides and SLA pinning, but we need a clear runtime contract. runtime currently expects `precision_profile` embedded in model config. If CrossPlane sets it, runtime needs either a `profile_id` header or an explicit `/v1/infer?profile_id=` param. Simpler is header. :thinking:

Samir: header sounds good. couple of tradeoffs:
- control-plane selection -> faster ops rollout but creates coupling between CP and runtime versions
- runtime-side fallback still required (e.g., client requests explicit profile for dev testing)

Samir: on quality telemetry we should emit a small event when CP overrides runtime profile: `{ event: "precision_override", profile_from: "model", profile_to: "cp:fast-int8", reason: "customer-pin" }` so evals can correlate regressions. also add `degradation_score` and `conf_interval` fields to downstream logs.

Devin K: agreed. propose this minimal API change: header `X-Precision-Profile: <profile_id>` which runtime honors if present, else falls back to model config. CrossPlane populates header when routing to runtime. Add a lightweight schema for telemetry events. Example CrossPlane config snippet: ```yaml
precision_policies:
  - customer_id: cust-42
    profile_id: cp:fast-int8
    rollout: canary:5%
    rollback_on:
      - metric: degradation_score
        threshold: 0.12
```

Mira S: love the snippet. operational notes: canary must sample both with and without KV cache to catch long-tail quality diffs. also we need a linting check in CP UI to prevent assigning experimental 4-bit profiles to enterprise SLAs.

Samir: for telemetry pipeline: tag events with `profile_source` (model|cp|request) and `profile_hash` for quick diffing. We should add a nightly job to run prompt-set evals against any profile changes > 1% Q-drop.

Devin K: ops plan: rollout path as steps: 1) add header support in runtime behind feature flag, 2) add CP UI toggle to set profile per-customer, 3) wire telemetry events, 4) 5% canary for 48h with alerting to #eng-ml if `degradation_score` > 0.08. anyone want to own step 1?

Mira S: I can pick up step 1 — will submit small PR: `runtime: honor X-Precision-Profile header (ff: cp_precision_header)` and include unit tests + integration test with mock CP.

Samir: I can wire the telemetry events and alert rules. will draft the schema and nightly eval job.

Devin K: awesome. assign owners and I'll add to RFC follow-up doc. thanks! :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag `cp_precision_header` will be toggled in staging at 2026-03-22T03:00Z. CI: ✅, smoke: pending.

Mira S: noted — will add integration test for header precedence (request header > CP header > model config).

Samir: also adding a short checklist for release notes so customers know when CP-driven profiles are used (transparency).

Devin K: perfect. leaving this thread open for any further edge-cases, but closing the ownership question — CP sets, runtime honors header, telemetry for quality.
